root_cause.text: In f2fs, the error path of f2fs_do_zero_range()/f2fs_zero_range() unconditionally updated the extent cache with `index - start` even when `index == start`, allowing insertion of a zero-length extent that violates extent_cache invariants and triggers a BUG in `__update_extent_tree_range`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `if (index > start)` around `f2fs_update_read_extent_cache_range(dn, start, 0, index - start);` and `f2fs_update_age_extent_cache_range(dn, start, index - start);`, while the CVE/commit message explicitly states that “In error path of f2fs_zero_range(), it may add a zero-sized extent into extent cache” and the crash log shows `__update_extent_tree_range: extent len is zero`.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: In f2fs, the error path of f2fs_do_zero_range()/f2fs_zero_range() unconditionally updated the extent cache with `index - start` even when `index == start`, allowing insertion of a zero-length extent that violates extent_cache invariants and triggers a BUG in `__update_extent_tree_range`.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds `if (index > start)` around `f2fs_update_read_extent_cache_range(dn, start, 0, index - start);` and `f2fs_update_age_extent_cache_range(dn, start, index - start);`, while the CVE/commit message explicitly states that “In error path of f2fs_zero_range(), it may add a zero-sized extent into extent cache” and the crash log shows `__update_extent_tree_range: extent len is zero`.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a guard to skip extent cache updates when the zeroed range length is not positive.
intent_record.what: The code wraps the two extent cache update calls in an `if (index > start)` condition, so `f2fs_update_read_extent_cache_range(dn, start, 0, index - start)` and `f2fs_update_age_extent_cache_range(dn, start, index - start)` are only executed when the computed range length is positive.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this prevents extent cache updates from being invoked with a zero or negative-length range when `index` is not greater than `start`, avoiding invalid or unnecessary cache range processing during zero-range handling.

grouping_result.intent: Add a guard to skip extent cache updates when the zeroed range length is not positive.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause by preventing extent cache updates when the computed zeroed length is zero or negative, avoiding insertion of a zero-length extent in the error path.

candidates.rationale: This unconditionally updates the read extent cache using `index - start` as the length. When `index == start` on the error path, it passes a zero-length extent, directly causing the invalid extent insertion described in the root cause.

This likewise unconditionally updates the age extent cache with a length of `index - start`. If that value is zero, it violates extent-cache invariants and contributes directly to the BUG triggered by zero-length extent updates.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement unconditionally updates the read extent cache with length `index - start`. On the error path where `index == start`, it submits a zero-length extent, violating extent cache invariants and leading to the BUG in `__update_extent_tree_range`.

This statement likewise unconditionally updates the age extent cache using `index - start` as the extent length. When that length is zero, it inserts an invalid zero-length extent and contributes directly to the crash condition described in the root cause.

The root cause is an unconditional extent-cache update on the error path using `index - start` even when `index == start`, which can create a zero-length extent. In this commit, the function still ends with `f2fs_update_read_extent_cache_range(dn, start, 0, index - start);` immediately before `return ret;`, with no guard checking that `index > start` or that the length is non-zero.     f2fs: support in batch fzero in dnode page
    
    This patch tries to speedup fzero_range by making space preallocation and
    address removal of blocks in one dnode page as in batch operation.
    
    In virtual machine, with zram driver:
    
    dd if=/dev/zero of=/mnt/f2fs/file bs=1M count=4096
    time xfs_io -f /mnt/f2fs/file -c "fzero 0 4096M"

bic_trace_step.reason: The vulnerable construct is directly present in the added helper `f2fs_do_zero_range()`. On the error path, the loop over blocks can break immediately when no block was successfully processed: `for (index = start; index < end; index++, dn->ofs_in_node++) { ... if (dn->data_blkaddr == NULL_ADDR) { ret = -ENOSPC; break; } ... }`. If that happens on the first iteration, then `index == start`. Despite that, the function unconditionally executes `f2fs_update_extent_cache_range(dn, start, 0, index - start);`. In that case, `index - start` is 0, so this attempts to update the extent cache with a zero-length extent, matching the root cause described. There is no guard such as `if (index > start)` or equivalent before updating the extent cache, so the fix is not present.
